preconditions.description: Both full_text and search_text must be strings.
search_text must be a non-empty string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(full_text) - len(search_text) + 1) if full_text[i:i+len(search_text)] == search_text)
postconditions.description: The return_value is the count of non-overlapping occurrences of search_text in full_text, where each occurrence starts at a distinct index in full_text.
